verdict.rationale: Unity's own Build Automation service provides first-party continuous-integration builds that run in the cloud, separate from the user's interactive session, and connect to version control. That makes it a documented background automation, though it is limited to builds. The headless mode, the CLI and the AI Assistant's prompt-driven "automate workflows" are one-off or building-block capabilities and do not by themselves create autonomous recurring automations. missing for 10: documented triggers or recurring schedules for automations, autonomous AI or agentic background tasks beyond CI builds, automations beyond builds, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Use Unity Build Automation and its continuous integration features for multiplatform builds.
Build Automation supports most popular version control systems and builds for multiple platforms simultaneously, including iOS.
